claim: craneLib.cargoTest creates a derivation running 'cargo test --profile release' in the workspace, with buildPhaseCargoCommand set accordingly, CARGO_PROFILE able to alter or omit the profile, and pnameSuffix set to '-test'.
stance_target: A crane-based CI gate can run the Rust MQTT agent's cargo tests as a Nix derivation
quoted_support: Create a derivation which will run a `cargo test` invocation in a cargo workspace. ... `buildPhaseCargoCommand` will be set to run `cargo test --profile release` in the workspace. - `CARGO_PROFILE` can be set on the derivation to alter which cargo profile is selected; setting it to `""` will omit specifying a profile altogether. * `pnameSuffix` will be set to `"-test"`

claim: cargoTest's optional attributes are cargoExtraArgs (default "--locked") and cargoTestExtraArgs (default ""), both appended to the cargo invocation and both REMOVED before lowering to mkCargoDerivation (recoverable via .overrideAttrs if needed as env vars).
stance_target: How to pass extra flags (e.g. select specific tests) into the cargoTest gate
quoted_support: * `cargoExtraArgs`: additional flags to be passed in the cargo invocation - Default value: `"--locked"` * `cargoTestExtraArgs`: additional flags to be passed in the cargo invocation - Default value: `""` ... The following attributes will be removed before being lowered to `mkCargoDerivation`.

claim: cargoTest delegates ALL other derivation attributes to mkCargoDerivation, which is a thin wrapper around stdenv.mkDerivation that passes attributes straight through as environment variables; nativeBuildInputs and buildInputs therefore behave as standard derivation inputs on the test derivation.
stance_target: Tests can be given access to mosquitto and dbus binaries inside the check by putting them in nativeBuildInputs in commonArgs
quoted_support: Except where noted below, all derivation attributes are delegated to `mkCargoDerivation`, and can be used to influence its behavior. ... A thin wrapper around `stdenv.mkDerivation` ... all derivation attributes are passed straight through, so any common derivation behavior can be used as expected: namely all key-value pairs will be set as environment variables for the derivation's build script.

claim: mkCargoDerivation automatically appends cargo, rustc, rsync, zstd and crane's hooks (cargoHelperFunctionsHook, inheritCargoArtifactsHook, installCargoArtifactsHook, configureCargoVendoredDepsHook, configureCargoCommonVarsHook, replaceCargoLockHook) as native build inputs alongside any caller-specified nativeBuildInputs.
stance_target: Extra tools like mosquitto/dbus are additive native build inputs, not replacements
quoted_support: #### Native build dependencies and included hooks The following packages and hooks are automatically appended as a native build input to any other `nativeBuildInputs` specified by the caller: * `cargo` ... * `rustc` * `rsync` * `zstd`

claim: cargoClippy sets buildPhaseCargoCommand to 'cargo clippy --profile release', takes cargoClippyExtraArgs (default '--all-targets', for denying specific lints) and cargoExtraArgs (default '--locked'), requires cargoArtifacts, and auto-appends clippy as a native build input.
stance_target: The already-failing clippy --deny warnings gate can be expressed as craneLib.cargoClippy with cargoClippyExtraArgs for the deny flags
quoted_support: `buildPhaseCargoCommand` will be set to run `cargo clippy --profile release` for the workspace. ... * `cargoClippyExtraArgs`: additional flags to be passed in the clippy invocation (e.g. deny specific lints) - Default value: `"--all-targets"` ... The `clippy` package is automatically appended as a native build input to any other `nativeBuildInputs` specified by the caller.

claim: cargoArtifacts (required for cargoTest/cargoClippy) is 'a path (or derivation) which contains an existing cargo target directory' prepared via buildDepsOnly or any cargo-based derivation built with doInstallCargoArtifacts = true, for incremental caching.
stance_target: Test and clippy gates should inherit cargoArtifacts from buildDepsOnly for CI caching
quoted_support: * `cargoArtifacts`: A path (or derivation) which contains an existing cargo `target` directory, which will be reused at the start of the derivation. Useful for caching incremental cargo builds. - This can be prepared via `buildDepsOnly` - Alternatively, any cargo-based derivation which was built with `doInstallCargoArtifacts = true` will work as well

claim: The check phase runs preCheck/postCheck hooks around checkPhaseCargoCommand (default '"${cargoTestCommand} ${cargoExtraArgs}"'), meaning custom setup like launching an ephemeral mosquitto broker can hook preCheck and teardown postCheck.
stance_target: An ephemeral broker can be started in preCheck and stopped in postCheck of a crane test derivation
scope_conditions: crane master docs/API.md, buildDepsOnly optional attributes (shared with mkCargoDerivation)
quoted_support: * `checkPhaseCargoCommand`: A command (likely a cargo invocation) to run during the derivation's check phase. Pre and post check hooks will automatically be run. - Default value: `"${cargoTestCommand} ${cargoExtraArgs}"` ... * `checkPhase`: the commands used by the check phase of the derivation - Default value: the check phase will run `preCheck` hooks, log and evaluate `checkPhaseCargoCommand`, and run `postCheck` hooks
